source.note: Generated from v1 by a script kept outside the repo; see README.md in this folder.

mappings: v1 parse result `{ ok: true, model }` -> `{ kind: "ok" }`; `{ ok: false, kind, message }` -> `{ kind, message }`.
Field renames (op args use the port names): participant `created` -> `isCreated`, activation `on` -> `isOn`, `wrap` -> `shouldWrap`, autonumber `visible` -> `isVisible`.
Op args are written in the port's signatures; the generator maps them to v1's positional arguments (setSectionLabel(m, blockId, sectionIndex, label), removeSection(m, blockId, sectionIndex)).

Item ids made in the editor are random, so args name items by position: `{ "$item": n }` is the id of the n-th item (depth first, source order) and `{ "$section": [n, s] }` is that block's list key `<id>:<s>`, both resolved against the model before the step.
Ops returning `{ model, id }` are compared on the model; `expected` is the serialized code after the step.

Layout: v1 `HH` -> `headH`, row `self` -> `isSelf`, column `destroyed` -> `isDestroyed`, bar `open` -> `isOpen`; `item`/`box` objects are replaced by their ids, a column's `p` (participant) is dropped, numbers rounded to 2 decimals.
Text is measured at 7px per character (v1's DOM-free fallback = approximateTextWidth in the port). Box titles: v1 asked CSS.supports; the generator answers with jsdom's CSS parser.
